title: Prerequisite Chain Diagnosis
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI-Native Schools
description: Trace a student's failure on a fractions-to-proportions prerequisite map back to the root gap in five illustrative cases.

learningObjectives: The learner will attribute a student's failure on a target concept to its root gap by examining a prerequisite map and a set of pass/fail results, correctly identifying the root gap in at least four of five cases.
prerequisites: Prior knowledge, prerequisite concept, root gap, and the meaning of a dependency arrow, from Chapter 2.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Diagnose cases on a dependency map, commit an answer, and read the reason
keyQuestions: Which failed concept has all of its prerequisites passed?
Is the target concept the root gap?
commonMisconceptions: The target concept the student failed is always the place to reteach
A concept that failed must have a failed prerequisite
assessmentOpportunities: Where is the root gap when Unit rates and Proportional equations fail but their prerequisites pass?
Is the failed target always the place to reteach?

controls.name: Concept nodes
controls.description: In explore mode, click to read a description. In a case, click to select the root gap.

controls.name: Submit
controls.description: Checks the selected concept against the root gap.

controls.name: Zoom in, Zoom out, Reset
controls.description: Change the view of the map. The mouse wheel does not zoom.
